description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to exceptional patient care.

As the DON, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and regulatory compliance. This is an outstanding opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents and foster a supportive, high-performing team environment.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience working in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated strong clinical knowledge, leadership, and management skills
Ability to ensure compliance with all state and federal regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, compensation based on experience.
